notes.title: Mount System✨: Diverse Captures and Functional Partners
notes.content: [p]In the vast continent of Redangard, animals of different shapes and monsters lurking around may become the loyal partners of adventurers in their adventurous journeys[b]✨[/b]. The mount system, as one of the game's core collection gameplay, provides adventurers with a rich variety of mobility options. Different kinds of mounts need to be acquired in specific ways, and each kind of mount represents a unique achievement of adventurers in their quest.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/1dc15a94aa0be07524001118defbccc7d6ef3038.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are many ways for adventurers to obtain mounts, including using creature traps to capture enemies, defeating specific monsters and taming them, completing quests for rewards, or achieving challenges for rewards.🎯[/p][p][/p][p][b]1.Basic Capture Method[/b]:[/p][p]Adventurers can use the Creature Trap to capture ordinary mounts in the wild. This basic capture method is suitable for every adventurer. By exploring the grass, forests 🌲, and other areas of the continent, they can find and take various wild creatures as their initial mounts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/bf44fb45f4cbf14490840393716991ef53866e4b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Battle Taming Challenge[/b]:[/p][p]You can directly challenge and defeat specific enemies to complete taming🐅. The mounts obtained in this way usually have better abilities and are a symbol of the adventurer's strength.[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Quest Rewards[/b]:[/p][p]By completing world quests, adventurers can earn special Engma Coin that can be used to purchase unique mounts from merchants around the world💰. This route allows adventurers to obtain their favorite mounts while advancing the main storyline.[/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Challenge Achievements Unlocked[/b]🏅:[/p][p]The game sets a variety of difficult challenges, and adventurers who successfully complete these challenges will win rare mount appearances. These special mounts often have unique appearance effects and attribute bonuses.[/p][p][/p][p]It is worth mentioning that adventurers can build their own ranches in the continent of Redangard. After building a ranch, adventurers will officially unlock the complete capture and taming system, gain more specialized taming tools and abilities, and lay the foundation for collecting more types of mounts. We've built this ranch system to ensure that almost any enemy or animal has a chance to become a mount, but each creature has its own specific capture method, providing adventurers with a wealth of collecting fun.🏡[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/ea6ba2a65a73f3021c988b312fb8d1a9078cb61b.gif"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p]The mount system not only provides a convenient way to move around, but is also deeply integrated into the gameplay. 🎮Basic mounts can significantly increase the speed of adventurers on the continent, making exploration more efficient. Some of the special mounts have unique environmental adaptability, such as the ability to move freely in poisonous swamps, maintain body temperature while traveling through lava, and even run fast on certain terrains. These special abilities provide more possibilities for adventurers to explore the world and become a key aid in raiding complex terrains.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/26cf37cae478d2fe24c2c0115352447cfc7fa49c.gif"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p]Each mount carries the memories of adventurers' adventures in Redangard📜, symbolizing their growth in the Second Era. From the first common mounts to the rare ones acquired in the later stages, adventurers' mount collections not only reflect their strength, but also record every bit of this fantastic journey.[/p]

notes.title: ✨Unlock the Gameplay of : Double Jump and Sprint!✨
notes.content:
In the world of <Galix: New Horizons> every corner hides an undiscovered secret, and every tower is waiting for the adventurer. In order to allow adventurers to travel more freely through this fantasy world, we have designed a double jump and the combo with double jump and sprint mechanism for our protagonist, Haily, to take you through the fun of exploration!🌌

🔥The double jump is not a simple jump superposition.

 In the first jump, Haily lightly jumped up to observe the surrounding environment; 👀

the second jump to enhance the height, to create the possibility of crossing the obstacles and easy to leap over the bottomless canyon🌊, climbed the towering cliffs. ⛰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/b1e789a998661f6a887c1de6696d98063c7828f2.gif[/img]


💨The combo of two jumps and sprints are also powerful, the first sprint instantly accelerated, quickly out of danger; 🚀

 the second sprint flexible steering, flexible performance in combat, whether it is to chase the enemy or in a variety of parkour environment, can be easy to handle.👾

 Of course, adventurers can use their imagination to fully utilize these abilities in the path of exploration, which may create an unexpected effect.✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/168288553ced84296894bd16f40249fd27e778d5.gif[/img]

⚠The path to acquiring these powerful abilities is full of challenges. You need to complete the tests in the quests and prove yourself with strength to unlock these abilities. When you unlock these abilities, a whole new world of adventure will open up for you! 🎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/3156ebd60a819afd86bae8e29f2e450a9a76f05c.gif[/img]

In the intense and exciting parkour gameplay, double jump and the combo of two jumps and sprints are considered to be divine powers. 💨

According to these special abilities, we will design a variety of intense and exciting parkour gameplay, for example, in the face of constantly collapsing platforms, you can rely on the height advantage of the two jumps, jumping onto the high platforms, the use of the two sprints of the flexible steering, in the narrow path of the rush forward, and race against the clock to challenge the ultimate speed.🚀

 Climbing tower gameplay, these two skills are equally important, each layer of the tower are full of organs and traps, two jumps to help you cross the abyss, climb to the top of the tower, two sprints will allow you to quickly break out of the enemy's pursuit.✨

 In all kinds of complex levels, whether it's a maze that requires precise jumping or a canyon that is full of crises, they will allow you to easily deal with them and discover the hidden pathways and precious rewards. 🔓
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/5f07781617f40f7a8db3166d2ee0d00bbdfb5cef.gif[/img]

The double jump and the combo of jump and sprint mechanics are not only a great tool for exploring the world, but also the key to unlocking the adventure. 🏃

Get ready to take on the challenge of unlocking these moves, and compose your own legendary adventure in <Galix: New Horizons>! 🌟

notes.title: Galix: New Horizons |Primordial Beast System Revealed: Raising Your Companion🐾
notes.content:
Dear adventurers, are you ready to step into the fantasy world of Galix: New Horizons and unlock brand new primordial beast companions? Today we bring you the game's super interesting new primordial beast beast system -- primordial beast raising gameplay, so you can immerse yourself in the joy of cultivation! ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/3f76a44a23d9599093221afa51138b9bb0dbd7ed.gif[/img]

In the vast world of Galix: New Horizons, the ways to obtain Spirit Eggs are full of surprises. When you take the side quests issued by NPCs, in the process of completing the commissions, you may be able to harvest the precious Spirit Eggs; when exploring the map, hidden corners and ancient relics may also hide Spirit Eggs, waiting for you to discover. Each Spirit Egg is the beginning of your marvelous relationship with the Beasts. They are the initial form of the Beasts, waiting for your careful care.💕

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/29b2d703db95eba86ae61ab19dca9f072b9322d7.gif[/img]

After picking up the Spirit Egg, raising it officially opens! Any medicine or food item in the game can be used to feed the Spirit Egg, which means that all those seemingly ordinary items in your backpack are useful. Different feeds will increase the value of the Spirit Egg, and the more you feed it, the more it grows, and when it reaches a certain level, it will hatch into a cute and powerful Beast. From now on, the Beast will follow you around like a loyal companion and accompany you on your free adventures. 🥚→🧚🏻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/f5841d4906e32755d733f4a7750d816900bbd554.gif[/img]

Primordial Beasts can directly boost your attribute values, giving you an edge in battle. Not only that, Primordial Beasts also have the special skill “Power of Primordial”, which will be the key to turn the tide of battle for you in a fierce battle! Whether you are exploring the large map or facing powerful bosses, Primordial Beasts can provide you with a powerful boost. ⚔️

And the primordial beast's growth doesn't stop there! You can continue to upgrade it by feeding it. As it level up, the beast will evolve into different forms depending on the direction you want to cultivate its abilities. Whether you want to develop it into a high-attack battle assistant or a defense-oriented guardian partner, it's up to you! Each evolution will bring a new appearance and more powerful strength. ⚡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/c3ce81da71bf2cad84cc5ee000637e332ccdd302.gif[/img]

Adventurers, do you want to have an exclusive and powerful primordial beast to fight alongside you in the Galix: New Horizons? Come and explore the game and start your primordial beast raising journey! There are more exciting gameplay waiting to be revealed, remember to stay tuned!🚀

notes.title: Ultimate Skill System Revealed!😎
notes.content:
Dear adventurers, today for you to deeply reveal the game's most innovative and fascinating ultimate skill system! 👋

In <Galix: New Horizons>🎮, there are various types of weapons in the arsenal for you to choose from, including the sword that is as strong as the wind, the great sword that is as heavy as the mountain, and the polearm that is as agile and elegant as ...... Even if they belong to the same category of weapons, they also have their own ultimate skills. The different weapons carry unique fighting styles and gorgeous special effects, the higher the star level of the weapon, the ultimate skills not only geometrically multiplied increase in power, the visual effect is also more and more shocking, so that adventurers more immersive experience of the battle! 🌟！
[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44991790/cc9e4355d299593975692081c090c9929b4e69d0.gif[/img]

To unleash the ultimate skill, the player needs to attack the enemies and save up energy slots during the battle. In the face of a tidal wave of monsters, the more courageous you are in battle, the faster you can unleash the destructive ultimate skill! Imagine, in the fierce battle with the powerful BOSS, in a dangerous situation, when the energy slot is full of the moment, press the ultimate skills button, the exclusive magnificent moves instantly bloom, or to give it a killing blow, and adventurers can experience the thrill and sense of accomplishment of this defeat for victory. ⚡
[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44991790/93b4d03f2a5ce657c2397ec40b3d95466786f02c.gif[/img]

Setting about the story behind the ultimate skills. In the future, we may set up a weapon with a mysterious spirit that possesses a separate consciousness and great power. In order to obtain the weapon's ultimate skill, you must engage in a thrilling battle with the spirits that reside in it. In the course of this intense battle, you will be able to communicate and bond with the spirits until you reach a state of mutual understanding. When you truly understand the spirit's will and empathize with it, you can unlock the ultimate power of the weapon - the Ultimate Technique! This is not only a battle of power, but also a dialog of the heart. Every battle with a spirit is a challenge and growth for yourself; every unlocked ultimate skill is a testimony to the deep bond you have with the spirit.💥
[img]https://clan.st.dl.eccdnx.com/images/44991790/bad2e3a49da32c6f5d2568758b17d62d413b3b1e.gif[/img]

In a world full of unknowns and challenges, resonate with the spirits, unleash the ultimate moves, and write your own legend! Keep following us for more exciting content to be revealed! 🎉

notes.title: GALIX: New Horizons Food Guide
notes.content:
Adventurers, today we reveal the super interesting cooking system of <Galix:New Horizons>! In this mysterious and vast world, food is no longer just a garnish, but also a powerful assistant on the road of adventure!🎉

In <Galix:New Horizons>, through the exploration of the game will unlock the cooking system, cooking system can be called a wonderful treasure in the journey of exploration. As you enter the vast forest, every blade of grass and every fruit tree holds a surprise. Sweet and sour wild berries🍓, crunchy nuts🌰, and even rare mushrooms🍄 that emit a mysterious aura are all excellent ingredients for cooking, while herbs growing along streams and secret spices deep in caves are key seasonings that enhance the flavor of your dishes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/8a6a4131c8eb218ceac51c645884ef674c380760.png[/img]

In addition to gathering ingredients in the natural environment, players can also hunt creatures to obtain unique cooking ingredients. When players successfully defeat these creatures, they will have the opportunity to obtain valuable meat, fur, and even some rare organs or blood, which can add a unique flavor and effect to the dishes.✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/5134634cde8c9d810cf81326c1880c0c724f6c6f.jpg[/img]

After collecting the ingredients🔥, players can utilize the campfire scene to create delicious dishes with their own hands. From simple kebabs to complex seafood feasts, the cooking process is full of fun and challenges. Each dish brings unique buff effects to the player. Eating delicious mushroom soup can greatly increase the speed of life recovery in battle; savoring spicy grilled fish can increase attack damage, helping you to be invincible in your adventure. But be careful⚠️, if you use the wrong ingredients to cook, you may cook strange food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/68579a5242a1fae3c1bc5e357d83404935e9509e.gif[/img]

In addition, the game also set up a recipe collection mechanism📜, with the exploration of the depth, players will unlock more mysterious recipes, to create a unique food, so that the cooking system has become an indispensable part of the exciting game adventure.

notes.title: 💫 Character Remastering Update💫
notes.content:
Today we're sharing exactly what we went through during the development of <Galix: New Horizons> with regards to the changes in character body proportions.🔅🌞🌙

In the early versions of the design, we expected to create a cartoon-style look. With this in mind, we designed the characters to have a five-headed proportions. The reason for this design was that we initially thought that this kind of fantasy and childlike look would make the character more suitable for a fun-filled adventure on a fantasy eco-planet.🌍🚀。

”Doesn't this look cute? 😊“（The left）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/74f3ef13c1ef12f652a58814836909b72590b745.png[/img]

We were confident when we finished development in isolation, yet nothing was as we had envisioned. After our initial modelling was complete, it felt a little off the idea ...... We seemed to have forgotten that we were making a game with an Asian aesthetic ...... The character in front of us looks like a big-headed doll that has had its figure forced into a cartoon style.🧸👀。

So various voices appeared🗣️：

“I won't buy a game with a protagonist who looks like this ......💸”

“Running and climbing stairs looks like a physical incongruity🤸”

“These legs aren't as long as my dogs' legs when they're stretched out🐶”

……

We also showed some other peers, and sure enough they all shook their heads at the same time, and finally even the producer himself couldn't stand it. He gritted his teeth and slapped his thighs, ‘Change it! Change everything!’💥

So we began to work overtime, because the character proportion of the re-creation, but also really let the previously produced animation had to be overturned to redo. (At this point the animator remembered that period of time on the silent wipe sweat) from the beginning to design animation and production to adapt to the new body, take a look at the effect is not better it ~ ~!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/a24754fbd0626c2f52779d7bb3903cc6dd5724d5.png[/img]

Change is not easy, but change is always good.🌟

Later I asked the producer, why did you make the character that way before? The producer said, ‘One leaf will always happen to everyone's eyes, so you still have to keep looking for reference coordinates, only then can it slowly get better. I thought to myself: please pay the overtime.💰💢

Lastly, let's talk about the changes brought about by this character image：

For every 5cm increase in character leg length, the animator's hairline is moved up by 1cm.👴💨

Combat action damage value increased by 200% (Because of the longer legs, the attack range is larger.)💥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/7b5fbb9101828cac1e8ecd3a43ec97b8937e5853.gif[/img]

Data shows that for every 10cm increase in leg length, the number of game screenshot clicks increases by 17%!🔥

This change is really an unforgettable experience for our little group~ I hope you enjoy the new version of Haily, and thank you for your support along the way!🙏🎮

notes.title: 🌟 What kind of small company can make an indie [open world] game anyway! 🌟
notes.content:
Good morning, good afternoon, good evening, and good night, everyone!    🌞🌞🌞As an indie game team that's still figuring things out, we're often asked a slightly questionable question: open world? Can a small team really handle that? 🤔

Yes, we're attempting this seemingly impossible task - <Galix: New Horizons> is exactly the kind of step we're taking into the open world realm with a small group of less than 10 people. We are aware of the disparity in resources between small teams and big companies, but we always believe: driven by creativity and love, we may be able to find a way to break the ice for independent teams.💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/bc1a1deceb0c483afc6e2d28ab84a09d39c73eec.jpg[/img]

🧩 [b]1. The meaning of modular development[/b]

Let's compare making this game to making Lego blocks, by turning the various parts of the game into modular components that can be assembled and disassembled very easily. Simply put, it means to make a set of LEGO model parts with good uniformity, and then use these parts to assemble various interesting things. Of course, it's not easy to do even that.

After quite a few difficulties, we are now a big step closer to realising this idea. We're getting a lot faster at designing content for the game. It's a great feeling to have the hard work come to an end. We're even thinking of making these modular development tools even simpler in the future if possible, so it would be nice to be able to open them up directly to players in the future!  🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/3a59addaa14eba937278e9749f22c0ff6b123df6.jpg[/img]

📣 [b]2、Take every opportunity to gather all kinds of opinions.[/b]

At the beginning of the project, we participated in BW and other exhibitions with early DEMO, and never thought that we could harvest hundreds of proposals that players wrote to us seriously. These thick reports carry players' expectations and suggestions, and also let us discover a lot of problems early, as well as confirm the reliability of many ideas. For small teams, the biggest hidden risk is the lack of a large number of gameplay tests and QA processes, and the insufficient sample size of information may lead to the development team's closed-door approach, so throughout the entire game development cycle, we will treat players as the biggest gameplay testing ally.
We're grateful to the players who tested an early version of the game last year for their input on the combat system, which has allowed us to improve the entire combat system significantly. 🗡️✨



👥 [b]3. Hexagonal warrior teams[/b]

It has been said that small teams must all be hexagonal warriors who can multi-task, and this is true, and that’s we do. But I'd like to talk more about what makes a hexagonal warrior a hexagonal warrior. For developers, the real logic behind hexagonal warrior is a support that puts the player experience first, and if we really take the perspective of a regular player, we get a feel for the experience of the game we're making. It will be found that a full-featured software is like making a meal, want the meal to taste especially good, there are very many details in the middle of the work to do. These details rely only on each person to do their job is difficult to fill, only when you really want to make the table meal particularly delicious, rather than just let people eat when, each person must take up more cross-border work. 🌟



💡 [b]4. Who was the genius who came up with the idea of ‘Parallel Thinking on Blighted Technologies’? I should thank him for inspiring a small team like ours.[/b]

We don't have million dollar motion capture equipment, we can only craft animations via hand-keyed keyframes, and we don't have super-detailed art modelling.
There's no Unreal Engine with its dreamlike and gorgeous graphics.
Undoubtedly, the best choice for a small team to make an open world game is to base on the mature technology that has been widely proved, and think more about how to make the game interesting. Despite this, developing a game like this can be difficult and daunting, but perhaps that's the fun of developing games, forcing us to think about the right way to do things in the midst of an uncertain future. We hope to have the support of our players to see if this small team can leave its mark on the sea of stars. 🌌✨

I just finished playing Split Fiction all night this weekend, and it's such a great game that I can't get enough of it, but after playing it, I was surprised to find that Galix: New Horizon's ‘fantasy world reborn on top of a scientific relic’ setting resonates wildly with Mio and Zoe's stitched-up secret world! (Does it look like that? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/0e6181ff7efb71dd0cf4cfd9cebd0a0f077f13be.jpg[/img]

 ⚡Sci-Fi vs Fantasy⚡

In fact, our ‘Galix: New Horizons’ is about a future where human civilization has fallen into ruins, and the Earth has evolved into a brand new ecological planet. The Ark is a relic that witnesses the glorious civilization of human, while beyond this relic, the continent of Redengard is a fantasy land full of magical ecology.

🤖In the game world, players can also choose from two very different growth paths:🤖：

 🔥开Pathfinder - Hot-blooded and courageous, you face the challenges of fast-paced combat head-on.

You cut through the darkness with a giant sword in your hand, and each victory brings you one step closer to world power. Battles are used to drive the plot forward, if you are a player who is keen on fast-paced battles and constant breakthroughs in battle power. Pathfinder will suit you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991790/83840fcf96cc38edf982e8dda41ab2ba6db444a0.jpg[/img]


🍄Inheritor - Patient and meticulous, indulging in the fun of exploration and nurturing

You will dig deep into the delights of all corners of the continent of Redengard and gradually unravel the mysteries hidden behind the world by collecting rare items, carefully raising your characters, and interacting deeply with the world. This path is for players who like to savour the game and enjoy the gradual accumulation of achievements.

notes.title: [GALIX:New Horizons] Recent Work Update
notes.content:
[img][/img]Hi Adventurer:


"GALIX:New Horizons" has attracted widespread attention from players since its launch on Steam. The development team works tirelessly every day to develop new content.

 Previously, we released the pre-alpha trailer, and we appreciate the discussions and feedback from players. [previewyoutube=DZmDSsgO_Lc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

In future development, we will gradually optimize "GALIX:New Horizons" as follows:

[b]Character Appearance Optimization[/b]
We will optimize the appearance of characters to better fit the game style.
Improve character clothing and details to make them more refined and unique.

[b]Character Action Optimization[/b]
In response to feedback about the lack of smoothness in character actions in early versions, we will improve the animation effects of characters.
Enhance the continuity and naturalness of actions to improve the overall visual experience.

[b]Enriching Game Content[/b]
We will add more storyline, tasks, and activities to enhance the depth and interest of the game.
Introduce more explorable scenes and interactive elements to enrich the gaming experience for players.


We will regularly update our development log in the future. We also hope you can provide your opinions and suggestions for "GALIX:New Horizons" in your spare time. We pay close attention to everyone's thoughts and invite you to witness our growth together. 

If you enjoy "GALIX:New Horizons," please actively leave us comments here! We hope to see more opinions and suggestions from you~
